title: Characterizing Localization Differences Between WT and KO Fibroblasts
author: Eve Pourzan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rr9d596
materials: Pipete up and down to resuspend cells
Cover plate with tinfoil to keep dark.
Using tool, pry off well walls.
View slides with EVOS using the manufacturers manual.

steps.title: Wash and resuspend cells
steps.instruction: Aspirate media, wash with PBS, trypsinize, stop, pellet, and resuspend cells in EMEM.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate old media from flask.
Add 5 mL PBS to wash, then aspirate.
Add 3 mL Trypsin to flask.
Incubate ~5 minutes to lift cells.
Add 3 mL EMEM media to stop trypsinization.
Pipette up and down to clear all cells from plate.
Transfer all media and cells to new labeled tubes.
Centrifuge at 4000 rpm for 5 minutes to create a cell pellet.
Aspirate off supernatant.
Add 1 mL EMEM media.
Pipette up and down to resuspend cells.

steps.title: Perform Trypan Blue viability assay
steps.instruction: Stain cells with Trypan Blue and count live vs. dead cells using the Countess machine.

substeps.instruction: Label Eppendorf tubes.
Pipette 10 µL Trypan Blue into each tube.
Add 10 µL designated cell solution into each tube.
Pipette up/down for good suspension.
Pipette 10 µL stained cell solution onto a labeled Countess slide.
Use Countess machine to count alive vs. dead cells; use microscope ZOOM function each time for an accurate count.

steps.title: Seed cells into 8‑well plate
steps.instruction: Prepare master mix to deliver 10,000 cells per well and incubate for 24 hours.

substeps.instruction: Calculate cells per well: 10,000 cells/well (20,000 cells/mL × 0.5 mL).
Determine master‑mix volumes using M1V1=M2V2 equation or the Countess count function.
Make master mixes with the calculated cell suspension.
Add 500 µL master‑mix cell solution to each well of the 8‑well plate.
Label the plate and incubate for 24 hours.

steps.title: Fix cells with formaldehyde
steps.instruction: Add 37 % formaldehyde to achieve a 1:10 dilution, let stand, then aspirate.

substeps.instruction: To each well containing 500 µL media, add 50 µL 37 % formaldehyde (final 1:10 dilution).
Let stand for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Aspirate off the media.
Optionally store the slide in a refrigerator or continue with downstream treatment.

steps.title: Block wells with BSA/Triton buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare blocking buffer, wash wells, block for 1 hour on a rotating tray at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Make blocking buffer: 0.5 g BSA powder + 30 µL Triton X‑100 + bring to 10 mL PBS.
Wash wells with 500 µL PBS, then aspirate.
Add 300 µL blocking buffer to each well.
Incubate on a room‑temperature rotating tray for 1 hour.

steps.title: Incubate primary antibody
steps.instruction: Dilute primary antibody 1:200 in BSA/Triton buffer, apply to wells, and incubate overnight in the cold room.

substeps.instruction: Make antibody dilution buffer: 0.1 g BSA powder + 30 µL Triton X‑100 + 10 mL PBS.
Prepare 1:200 primary‑antibody dilution: 1 mL antibody dilution + 5 µL primary antibody.
Remove plate from rotating tray.
Aspirate off blocking buffer.
Add 400 µL antibody dilution to control wells and 400 µL antibody dilution containing primary antibody to experimental wells.
Incubate on a rocker overnight in the cold room.

steps.title: Incubate secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Prepare 1:500 secondary‑antibody dilution, apply, protect from light, incubate 1 hour at room temperature, then wash.

substeps.instruction: Prepare secondary‑antibody dilution buffer (if needed): 0.1 g BSA + 30 µL Triton X‑100 + 10 mL PBS (can use leftover from primary buffer).
Make 1:500 secondary‑antibody dilution: 1 mL secondary‑antibody buffer + 2 µL secondary antibody; keep covered in foil and protected from light.
Retrieve plate from cold room.
Aspirate off primary‑antibody mix.
Wash wells three times with 500 µL PBS each.
Add 400 µL secondary‑antibody dilution to every well.
Cover plate with foil and incubate on a rocking tray at room temperature for 1 hour.
Wash wells three times with 500 µL PBS.

steps.title: Mount DAPI and coverslip
steps.instruction: Add DAPI drops, gently place coverslip, and let adhere for at least 30 minutes in foil.

substeps.instruction: Using a tool, pry off the well walls.
Add one small drop of DAPI to the floor of each well.
Gently place a coverslip on top of the DAPI drops without pressing down.
Cover the plate with foil and let sit for ≥30 minutes; the coverslip will adhere to the plate.
